描述_EN: 'a chinese dream' is one of a series of quilts by susan stockwell, which includes 'imperial quilt' made of maps of the world reconfigured with the middle east at the centre and a swatch of america woven into every continent. 'a chinese dream' has been created from one of the most transferable and anonymous paper objects within contemporary society - money. gathered and collected, the materials in all the quilts refer to politics and trade and use of everyday familiar materials. susan stockwell believes that the continuing relevance of quilts lies in their connection to a 'make do and mend' mentality where recycling and ecology are an inherent part of the process of making. through the careful selection of both crsip, newly printed chinese bank notes, and the slightly weathered notes already in circulation, stockwell creates a visually arresting piece which is also a political statement of the importance of china to the global trade network. the artist believes the strength and efficiency of this national economcy contributes to china's wider global relevance, particularly to the textile trade.
描述_ZN: '中国梦'是Susan Stockwell的系列被子之一，其中包括'帝国被子'，由世界地图重新配置而成，以中东为中心，每个大洲都有一块美国的图案。 "中国梦 "是由当代社会中最容易转移和匿名的纸质物品之一--钱创造的。 采集和收集，所有被子中的材料都是指政治和贸易以及日常熟悉材料的使用。 苏珊-斯托克韦尔认为，被子的持续相关性在于它们与 "做了就补 "的心态有关，在这种心态下，回收和生态是制作过程中的一个固有部分。 通过精心挑选新印制的中国纸币和已经流通的略微风化的纸币，Stockwell创造了一个视觉上引人注目的作品，这也是对中国在全球贸易网络中重要性的政治声明。 艺术家认为这个国家经济的实力和效率有助于中国更广泛的全球相关性，特别是对纺织品贸易。
